shots.purpose: Turn Noa's reluctant cheek pose into a cat-paw gesture without resetting her hands, then motivate the framing change.
shots.reason_for_existence: Keep the cute performance physically continuous and create an intentional exit into the wide reveal.

camera.movement: locked until the palm fully occludes the lens

entry_state.left_hand: left index fingertip touching left cheek
entry_state.right_hand: right index fingertip touching right cheek
entry_state.wardrobe: ivory cardigan, black ribbon, charcoal skirt and black tights
entry_state.environment: same warm off-white streaming room, chair and plant
entry_state.camera_relation: seated close to the fixed phone camera

beats.action: Hold both fingertips on the cheeks for one embarrassed beat.
beats.state_change: No spatial change; the expression softens slightly.

beats.action: Without lowering either hand, curl the extended fingers into small loose cat paws beside the cheeks.
beats.state_change: Cheek-pointing hands become cat paws in place.

beats.action: Perform one small synchronized inward paw motion and settle.
beats.state_change: Both paws return beside the cheeks after one gesture.
beats.attention: A restrained tsundere performance, not idol-like exaggeration.

beats.action: Extend the right palm toward the lens until it fully covers the frame while the left paw stays near the cheek.
beats.state_change: The image becomes fully occluded by the right palm.
beats.attention: A motivated transition rather than a decorative title card.

exit_state.body_pose: still seated behind the fully extended right arm
exit_state.left_hand: left hand held as a loose paw beside the cheek
exit_state.right_hand: right palm fully covering the lens
exit_state.wardrobe: ivory cardigan, black ribbon, charcoal skirt and black tights
exit_state.environment: same warm off-white streaming room, chair and plant
exit_state.camera_relation: right palm in contact distance with the fixed phone lens

keyframes.description: Both index fingertips remain on the cheeks at the start of the shot.
Both hands have changed into loose cat paws without dropping below frame.
The right palm fills and fully occludes the frame.

shots.purpose: Reveal Noa at full-body scale and let her settle into the dance-challenge ready pose.
shots.reason_for_existence: The occluded edit makes the necessary camera-distance and body-position change intentional.

entry_state.body_pose: standing several steps back with weight centered
entry_state.right_hand: right hand open in a small presentation pose
entry_state.wardrobe: ivory cardigan, black ribbon, charcoal skirt and black tights
entry_state.environment: same warm off-white streaming room, chair and plant
entry_state.camera_relation: standing several steps from the fixed phone camera

beats.action: Give one restrained presentation motion, then settle into a simple dance-ready stance.
beats.state_change: Presentation pose becomes a stable dance starting pose.
beats.attention: The full-body reveal and poised finish.

exit_state.body_pose: standing in a stable dance-challenge ready stance
exit_state.left_hand: left hand in the approved dance starting position
exit_state.right_hand: right hand in the approved dance starting position
exit_state.wardrobe: ivory cardigan, black ribbon, charcoal skirt and black tights
exit_state.environment: same warm off-white streaming room, chair and plant
exit_state.camera_relation: standing several steps from the fixed phone camera

keyframes.description: Noa is already framed full body after the deliberate occluded edit.
Noa finishes in a stable dance-challenge starting pose.

warnings: The occlusion route is a deliberate edit; it preserves story continuity but not literal body-position continuity across the hidden cut.
